verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that the Vanta API can automate evidence collection from security awareness training systems. That is a developer building block for ingesting data from external training tools, not built-in training. Nothing in the pack shows training assigned on hire or tracked to completion natively within Vanta.

support.subject: As an operations lead, security awareness training is built in — assigned on hire, tracked to completion, and accepted as audit evidence
